messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated p95 latency and a spike in 5xx for model variant 'mistral-lite-v1' in us-west-2 (svc=runtime-proxy). Grouping keys: model.variant:mistral-lite-v1, region:us-west-2
raj: acked — paging in. seeing ~18% 5xx and p95 ~2.4s, normal is ~350ms. @anna you free?
anna: on it, pulling traces now. if this is model-level maybe need to route heavy keys off.
kevin: fyi a few larger PLG customers reported slow responses via support. maya can you summarize customer impact?
maya: support: 3 tickets so far, twoached users have timeouts in chat flows, one customer escalated to CSM. estimated affected qps ~120 from heavy keys.
raj: triage: cause unknown. hypotheses: bad kernel path for quantized build or KV cache pressure in that variant. mitigation options: 1) immediate full disable of mistral-lite-v1 globally 2) steer traffic for heavy API keys to stable variant 3) per-region disable in us-west-2. prefer option 2 or 3 to avoid global churn.
anna: agree. start with steering heavy keys in us-west-2 to stable-2025-03. we'll also incrementally reduce weight for all traffic if needed.
raj: plan: run routing change targeting keys in heavy_keys_usw2.json and set weight -> stable-2025-03 100% for those keys. also apply a short-term quota reduction for non-critical keys to prevent cascade. will run commands now and monitor.
raj: @devops-bot run: `redwood route modify --from mistral-lite-v1 --to stable-2025-03 --region us-west-2 --keys-file heavy_keys_usw2.json --force`
devops-bot: ok: routing job created (job_id=rt-20250315-73). estimated propagation ~15s.
anna: also applying emergency per-key throttle for top 10 keys: `redwood quotas set --keys top10-keys.json --qps 5 --window 60s`
devops-bot: quotas updated (change_id=q-331).
raj: monitoring: p95 has started to drop in us-west-2 to ~480ms, 5xx down to 4%. still watching error types (502/504).
kevin: any logs showing OOM or kernel errors?
anna: seeing a pattern: KV cache misses spike then slow disk read latencies for that variant under long context sequences. looks like an oversize-memory-path hit for mistral-lite-v1 in this region.
maya: updated customers: told three customers we've routed them to a stable variant and they should see lower latency in ~1 minute. CSM looped.
raj: ok continue monitoring for 20m. next steps if it persists: 1) promote canary stable variant globally 2) fully disable mistral-lite-v1 in us-west-2 and schedule rollback patch for the quantized kernels.
kevin: prepping a rollback package for mistral-lite-v1 quantized runtime. might be a week fix; need to keep variant out of heavy traffic.
anna: removing experimental fallback routes for mistral-lite-v1 from auto-balance so it doesn't get routed back by autoscaler. `redwood config set autoscale.routing.block_variants "[\"mistral-lite-v1\"]" --region us-west-2`
devops-bot: config applied (cfg=cfg-711).
raj: handoff: I'll stay live for 10 more minutes then hand to anna for the midnight shift. anna you're oncall after me. any objections?
anna: i can take it. will keep a watch and start a postmortem doc if mitigation holds.
maya: support update: two customers confirmed improvement, one still seeing occasional spikes — asking for logs.
raj: mark incident as mitigated for now — heavy keys rerouted and quota throttles in place. leaving an action item for eng to disable the variant for non-experimental paths until kernel patch (ACTION: eng/kevin create patch ticket and schedule).
kevin: creating ticket INT-4582: rollback/patch mistral-lite-v1 quantized kernel. linking logs.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, impacted_region=us-west-2, primary_mitigation=targeted_routing+per-key-quotas, owner=anna, incident_id=inc-20250315-19
anna: copy. i'll do a 1hr post-mitigation check and then start a short RCA doc with timeline + customer impact + recommended safeguards (prefill canary weight limits, autoscale blocklist for experimental variants).
raj: thanks everyone. handing off to anna — i'll join async if needed.
anna: thanks — leaving note for next oncall: keep mistral-lite-v1 blocked from autoscale and don't restore variant until INT-4582 resolved and validated.
kevin: adding validation tests for KV cache miss patterns to CI.
maya: I'll close customer tickets once we confirm stable for 1h.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: status=closed_by_oncall, closed_by=anna, closed_ts=1951230450
